:::{#exm-cind-continuous}
#### Two measurements of the same continuous quantity
<!-- no-figure: algebraic derivation, no data to plot -->

Let $X$ be a [continuous random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-continuous-rv) with density $\p(X = x)$,
and suppose that, given $X = x$, the measurements $Y_1$ and $Y_2$ are independent, each with density $\p(Y_i = y_i \mid X = x)$.
Then $Y_1$ and $Y_2$ are conditionally independent given $X$ (@def-cind-continuous):

$$
\ba
\frac{\p(X = x, Y_1 = y_1, Y_2 = y_2)}{\p(X = x)}
&= \p(Y_1 = y_1, Y_2 = y_2 \mid X = x)
&& \text{(definition of a conditional density)} \\
&= \p(Y_1 = y_1 \mid X = x) \cd \p(Y_2 = y_2 \mid X = x)
&& \text{(independence given } X = x \text{)} \\
&= \frac{\p(X = x, Y_1 = y_1)}{\p(X = x)} \cd \frac{\p(X = x, Y_2 = y_2)}{\p(X = x)}
&& \text{(definition of a conditional density)}
\ea
$$

:::
